servicesIntro: Detailing, correction and coating for paint, fiberglass and gel coat.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: SB3 nano ceramic coating with clay bar and iron decontamination, in 1-, 3-, 5- and 7-year options.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Machine polishing and compounding in 1-, 2- and 3-step packages to remove swirls, oxidation and water spots.

services.name: Mobile Auto Detailing
services.text: Foam wash, decontamination and interior deep cleaning at your location.

services.name: Boat Detailing
services.text: Hull washing, decontamination, gel coat polishing and oxidation removal at your slip, dry storage or dock.

services.name: RV Detailing
services.text: Exterior wash, AIO polish and interior detailing, with ceramic coating options.

services.name: Headlight Restoration
services.text: Cloudy lenses wet sanded, polished and sealed with a ceramic coating.
